description: This source file defines data structures and utilities for displaying and managing tool descriptions in a user interface, including configuration loading, resolution logic, and text formatting.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: A struct representing a summary of a tool's display properties, including name, emoji, title, label, verb, and detail. It also provides computed properties for formatted lines.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: A namespace with static methods and nested structs managing the configuration and resolution of tool display summaries, including configuration loading, default setup, and helper functions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a ToolDisplaySummary based on the provided name, arguments, and optional metadata, applying configuration and fallback logic.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the tool display configuration from a JSON resource file.

methods.name: defaultConfig
methods.description: Provides a default tool display configuration in case loading from file fails.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable title from a sanitized name string.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes a verb string by trimming and replacing underscores.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string for 'read' actions from the args.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Creates a detail string based on a path from the args.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Returns the first non-nil rendered string value from the args for a list of keys.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a value (String, Number, Bool, Array, Dictionary) into a descriptive string.

methods.name: valueForKeyPath
methods.description: Extracts a nested value from args given a dot-separated key path.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces the user home directory path with '~' in the given string.
